name: drg-0001-goal1
goal: Outline every neuron cell body and count them, leaving out the satellite glia and Schwann cells around them.

look.notes: The provided images are not suitable for precise cell counting. The number of neurons is estimated based on the known density of DRG neurons and the image scale, but this is an approximation. The images are fluorescence microscopy images of a rat dorsal root ganglion section stained with an antibody against neurofilament, which labels neuronal cell bodies and processes. The structures visible are neurons, identifiable by their stained cell bodies and processes. The exact number of neurons cannot be determined from these images without quantitative analysis software.
